content.text:
Flight's over (line items ran through Dec 4, 2026 05:00 UTC / midnight ET). Here's the recap:

## Kovireel Christmas Trials — Nov 30–Dec 3, 2026 (America/New_York)

**Totals (all 3 ad groups, ALL_ON_TWITTER):**
- Spend: **$818.37** of $950 budget
- Impressions: **292,258**
- Link clicks: **194** (~$4.22/click avg)

**By ad group:**
| Ad group / post | Spend | Impr. | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gift Invitation (2125635624760588388) | $419.63 | 136,144 | 124 |
| Dec 24 Deadline (2125998012628324638) | $313.11 | 109,561 | 61 |
| Price Transparency (2126179206560378851) | $85.63 | 46,553 | 9 |

**What I did:** Launched one campaign ("Kovireel Christmas Trials 2026") with three line items, US-only + 18+ + anime-interest targeting (trials are US 18+ per the landing page), optimized for link clicks since there's no X pixel — trial starts can only be counted in your own signup records, so I optimized for the closest available signal. Post 2125454430828252428 ("Two classics…") couldn't be promoted — it wasn't returned as a published/promotable post, so I left it out. Post 2125816818695947215 ("Thanks for taking a look…") was promotable but had no offer/urgency, so I didn't spend on it.

**Optimizations:** Dec 1 — shifted budget toward the Gift Invitation creative ($100/day vs $75) and cut Price Transparency to $25/day (worst cost/click). Dec 2 — paused Price Transparency entirely and raised Gift Invitation to $125/day and Dec 24 Deadline to $85/day. Gift Invitation was the clear winner throughout.

**Caveats / notes:**
- Trial starts themselves are not visible to X; I can't report conversions — only clicks/impressions/spend. Your signup records are the source of truth for the actual goal.
- Spend came in under budget ($818 vs $950) because the paused Price Transparency line stopped drawing; I didn't reallocate the remainder in the final hours.
- The "Two classics…" post appears not to exist as a published post on the account — worth checking on your side.
- All promoted copy was consistent with the landing page (14-day trial, US 18+, $6.99/mo auto-renew after trial, Dec 24 offer deadline).
